我该怎么退出这个仓库？

nodes.prose: 作为协作者（Collaborator）退出： 点击顶部导航栏最右侧的 Settings （设置）。 在左侧菜单栏中，点击 Collaborators （或 Access 下的协作者管理）。 在协作者列表中找到你的用户名，点击右侧的 Leave （离开）或垃圾桶图标（ Remove ），确认即可。 作为仓库所有者（Owner）： 如果你是该仓库的创建者/拥有者，不能直接“退出”，可以选择以下两种方式之一： 彻底删除仓库 ：进入 Settings 页面滑到最底部的 Danger Zone 点击 Delete this repository 并按提示确认。 转让仓库所有权 ：进入 Settings Danger Zone 点击 Transfer ownership 转让给其他账号或组织。
nodes.text:
作为协作者（Collaborator）退出：

点击顶部导航栏最右侧的 Settings（设置）。

在左侧菜单栏中，点击 Collaborators（或 Access 下的协作者管理）。

在协作者列表中找到你的用户名，点击右侧的 Leave（离开）或垃圾桶图标（Remove），确认即可。

作为仓库所有者（Owner）：

如果你是该仓库的创建者/拥有者，不能直接“退出”，可以选择以下两种方式之一：

彻底删除仓库：进入 Settings 
→
→ 页面滑到最底部的 Danger Zone 
→
→ 点击 Delete this repository 并按提示确认。

转让仓库所有权：进入 Settings 
→
→ Danger Zone 
→
→ 点击 Transfer ownership 转让给其他账号或组织。

nodes.prose: 我该怎么退出这个仓库？

作为协作者（Collaborator）退出： 点击顶部导航栏最右侧的 Settings （设置）。 在左侧菜单栏中，点击 Collaborators （或 Access 下的协作者管理）。 在协作者列表中找到你的用户名，点击右侧的 Leave （离开）或垃圾桶图标（ Remove ），确认即可。 作为仓库所有者（Owner）： 如果你是该仓库的创建者/拥有者，不能直接“退出”，可以选择以下两种方式之一： 彻底删除仓库 ：进入 Settings 页面滑到最底部的 Danger Zone 点击 Delete this repository 并按提示确认。 转让仓库所有权 ：进入 Settings Danger Zone 点击 Transfer ownership 转让给其他账号或组织。

nodes.prose: 以下是项目要求文件 Data Structures PJ1 的中文翻译： 数据结构作业：PJ1 概述 在本项目中，你需要实现一个 AVL 树 和一个 红黑树 ，比较它们的实证性能，利用理论性质解释其差异，并针对红黑树提出一种可能的改进方案 。这两种树必须对外暴露相同的有序集合（ordered-set）接口，以便实验比较的是数据结构本身而非无关的代码程序 。你可以使用课程批准的任意编程语言 。除非任务中另有明确说明，否则实现代码、正确性证明和性能分析必须由你独立完成 。 每个节点存储一个可比较的值（例如 64 位有符号整数），值本身决定了大小顺序 。节点值是唯一的：插入已存在的值不会创建第二个节点 。除非另有说明，查找或删除失败属于正常操作，不得导致程序崩溃 。 1. 通用接口与规范 为每种树结构提供以下逻辑操作的实现 。方法名称可根据编程语言习惯有所不同，但含义和返回值必须在 README 中说明 。 操作 必须实现的行为 insert(value) 插入指定值；返回是否插入了新值 。 find(value) 返回该值是否存在 。 erase(value) 如果存在则移除该值；返回是否发生了移除 。 size() 返回当前存储的值的个数 。 empty() 返回树是否为空 。 clear() 移除所有值并释放所占用的内存 。 inorder() 按严格递增顺序返回或遍历所有值 。 height() 使用某种明确声明的规范返回树的高度（必须说明空树的高度定义） 。 validate() 检查元素顺序以及所有的平衡/颜色不变量（用于测试） 。 print_standard() 打印第 4 节中要求的标准层序/递归表示形式 。 公共接口 不得 泄露特定实现的平衡调整步骤 。树拥有其节点的所有权，不得发生内存泄漏 。如果红黑树使用了哨兵节点（ NIL ），需说明其是否计入树的高度的计算或输出中（ 绝对不能 将其作为数据节点打印出来） 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 仅可用于澄清语言语法或工具链的使用，不得用于设计、实现或解释这些接口 。 2. AVL 树 实现一个支持第 1 节中所有操作的 AVL 树，包括插入和删除时的重新平衡（Rebalancing） 。每个真实节点必须维护足够的元数据以高效计算平衡因子（通常是高度或平衡状态字段） 。在每次成功更新后，所有节点必须满足 AVL 不变量 ： 实现并使用四种旋转情况（LL、RR、LR、RL），或等价拆分为单次旋转的操作 。 你的报告必须包含更新重平衡的伪代码或简要解释、不变量的证明概要，以及查找、插入、删除和额外空间复杂度的最坏情况渐进界限 。同时需注明代码中使用的高度规范 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 不得编写或重写 AVL 的实现代码、平衡逻辑、伪代码、证明或复杂度分析 。 3. 红黑树 实现一个支持相同接口的红黑树 。可以使用共享的 NIL 哨兵节点或 null 子节点，但必须明确说明说明你的选择 。每个真实节点必须包含颜色属性，实现代码必须维护以下不变量 ： 每个节点要么是红色，要么是黑色；根节点是黑色 。 所有 叶子节点都被视为黑色 。 红色节点的子节点必须都是黑色 。 从任意节点到其后代 叶子节点的所有路径上，包含相同数量的黑色节点 。 必须实现插入修复（Insertion fix-up）和删除修复（Deletion fix-up）；不得使用标准库的有序集合或树函数替代你自己的实现 。报告中必须解释每种修复步骤处理的情况，给出不变量维持的证明概要，并给出所有必需操作的最坏情况界限 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 不得编写或重写红黑树实现、修复情况处理、伪代码、证明或复杂度分析 。 4. 标准树输出与可测试性 两种实现都必须提供 print_standard() （或文档中说明的等效函数），输出格式必须是确定性的、可进行逐字节对比的结构 。使用括号递归打印树：每个真实节点写为 (value left right) ，其中 left 和 right 是其子节点的括号表示形式 。缺失的子节点写为 () ，因此空树表示为 () 。 对于 AVL 树，仅打印节点的值 。 对于红黑树，打印节点值及其颜色标志 :R 或 :B ； 不要 打印高度元数据 。 节点内部的标记用单个空格分隔，结尾不要添加多余空格 。 例如，一个有效的红黑树输出如下 ： 如果你的编程语言无法保持文本字面格式，请提供一个包含完全相同 Token 的确定性文本文件输出，并说明调整方式 。测试部分需包含针对空树、重复插入、失败操作、已排序及逆序插入、所有旋转/修复情况的自动测试，以及在随机混合操作后调用 validate() 进行的不变量检查 。 AI 使用规定： 允许使用 ，但仅限于标准输出格式化、测试用例设计和测试代码编写 。数据结构的实现代码和不变量检查逻辑必须由你亲自编写 。 5. 性能实验与理论分析 对两种树使用统一的驱动程序（Driver）和完全相同的操作序列 。至少测量跨越一个数量级以上的三个输入规模（例如 、 和 个值，具体可根据实际限制调整） 。测试负载必须至少包含以下场景 ： 随机唯一值插入 ； 顺序插入（Sorted insertion） ； 逆序插入（Reverse-sorted insertion） ； 包含成功查找、失败查找、插入和删除的混合负载 。 在计时前进行预热（Warm up），计时区域内 排除 输入生成和打印的时间；每个测量重复足够的次数以报告稳定的统计数据，并说明你报告的是均值、中位数还是其他统计量 。在每个工作负载结束后验证正确性并调用 validate() 。报告实际经过的时间（Wall-clock time），如果条件允许，还可记录比较/旋转/重配色计数器 。展示表格或图表，并解释性能波动的来源 。 将测量结果与理论联系起来：对比 AVL 树的高度界限 与红黑树的高度界限（最高为 ）；解释为什么 AVL 树可以拥有更短的查找路径，而红黑树的更新操作所需的重平衡可能更少 。讨论性能对工作负载的依赖性，而不是简单声称某种数据结构普遍更快 。 AI 使用规定： 对于实验设计决策、数据收集、数据解读、理论解释和绘图， 禁止使用 AI 。仅在第 4 节允许的范围内可以使用 AI 生成的绘图/测试样板代码；所有数据必须来自你自己的运行结果 。 6. 红黑树改进建议 根据你的测量结果以及文献/AI 辅助的研究，探讨改善红黑树或相关平衡二叉搜索树的一个可能方向 。以下是几个宽泛的研究方向，你可以选择其中之一或提出其他有据可查的方向 ： 内存表示、分配与局部性（Locality） ； 平衡维护与更新策略 ； 并发与并行处理 ； 感知工作负载（Workload-aware）的结构与操作 。 说明核心思想、预期收益以及主要权衡（Trade-off） 。明确区分已实现的结果和提议的研究方向，并在适当位置引用相关文献来源 。 AI 使用规定： 允许使用 ，但仅限于研究和头脑风暴改进建议、寻找相关参考文献以及比较可能的研究方向 AVL 树 实现一个支持第 1 节中所有操作的 AVL 树，包括插入和删除时的重新平衡（Rebalancing） 。每个真实节点必须维护足够的元数据以高效计算平衡因子（通常是高度或平衡状态字段） 。在每次成功更新后，所有节点必须满足 AVL 不变量 ： 实现并使用四种旋转情况（LL、RR、LR、RL），或等价拆分为单次旋转的操作 。 你的报告必须包含更新重平衡的伪代码或简要解释、不变量的证明概要，以及查找、插入、删除和额外空间复杂度的最坏情况渐进界限 。同时需注明代码中使用的高度规范 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 不得编写或重写 AVL 的实现代码、平衡逻辑、伪代码、证明或复杂度分析 。 3. 红黑树 实现一个支持相同接口的红黑树 。可以使用共享的 NIL 哨兵节点或 null 子节点，但必须明确说明说明你的选择 。每个真实节点必须包含颜色属性，实现代码必须维护以下不变量 ： 每个节点要么是红色，要么是黑色；根节点是黑色 。 所有 叶子节点都被视为黑色 。 红色节点的子节点必须都是黑色 。 从任意节点到其后代 叶子节点的所有路径上，包含相同数量的黑色节点 。 必须实现插入修复（Insertion fix-up）和删除修复（Deletion fix-up）；不得使用标准库的有序集合或树函数替代你自己的实现 。报告中必须解释每种修复步骤处理的情况，给出不变量维持的证明概要，并给出所有必需操作的最坏情况界限 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 不得编写或重写红黑树实现、修复情况处理、伪代码、证明或复杂度分析 。 4. 标准树输出与可测试性 两种实现都必须提供 print_standard() （或文档中说明的等效函数），输出格式必须是确定性的、可进行逐字节对比的结构 。使用括号递归打印树：每个真实节点写为 (value left right) ，其中 left 和 right 是其子节点的括号表示形式 。缺失的子节点写为 () ，因此空树表示为 () 。 对于 AVL 树，仅打印节点的值 。 对于红黑树，打印节点值及其颜色标志 :R 或 :B ； 不要 打印高度元数据 。 节点内部的标记用单个空格分隔，结尾不要添加多余空格 。 例如，一个有效的红黑树输出如下 insertion） ； 包含成功查找、失败查找、插入和删除的混合负载 。 在计时前进行预热（Warm up），计时区域内 排除 输入生成和打印的时间；每个测量重复足够的次数以报告稳定的统计数据，并说明你报告的是均值、中位数还是其他统计量 。在每个工作负载结束后验证正确性并调用 validate() 。报告实际经过的时间（Wall-clock 对于实验设计决策、数据收集、数据解读、理论解释和绘图， 禁止使用 AI 。仅在第 4 节允许的范围内可以使用 AI 生成的绘图/测试样板代码；所有数据必须来自你自己的运行结果 。 6. 红黑树改进建议 根据你的测量结果以及文献/AI 辅助的研究，探讨改善红黑树或相关平衡二叉搜索树的一个可能方向 。以下是几个宽泛的研究方向，你可以选择其中之一或提出其他有据可查的方向 ： 内存表示、分配与局部性（Locality） ； 平衡维护与更新策略 ； 并发与并行处理 ； 感知工作负载（Workload-aware）的结构与操作 。 说明核心思想、预期收益以及主要权衡（Trade-off） 。明确区分已实现的结果和提议的研究方向，并在适当位置引用相关文献来源 。 AI 使用规定： 允许使用 ，但仅限于研究和头脑风暴改进建议、寻找相关参考文献以及比较可能的研究方向 。任何原型代码、测量数据和最终的技术判断必须由你独立完成并明确标识 。 7. 提交内容要求 将所有文件放入名为 pj1 的目录中 。该目录必须包含 ： 两种树及通用驱动程序的源代码 ； 自动化测试代码以及运行测试所需的微型测试数据 ； README （或 README.md ），说明先决条件、编译器/解释器版本、构建命令、测试命令、实验运行命令、命令行参数、输入格式、输出格式以及如何复现实验数据 AVL 树 实现一个支持第 1 节中所有操作的 AVL 树，包括插入和删除时的重新平衡（Rebalancing） 。每个真实节点必须维护足够的元数据以高效计算平衡因子（通常是高度或平衡状态字段） 。在每次成功更新后，所有节点必须满足 AVL 不变量 ： 实现并使用四种旋转情况（LL、RR、LR、RL），或等价拆分为单次旋转的操作 。 你的报告必须包含更新重平衡的伪代码或简要解释、不变量的证明概要，以及查找、插入、删除和额外空间复杂度的最坏情况渐进界限 。同时需注明代码中使用的高度规范 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 不得编写或重写 AVL 的实现代码、平衡逻辑、伪代码、证明或复杂度分析 。 3. 红黑树 实现一个支持相同接口的红黑树 。可以使用共享的 NIL 哨兵节点或 null 子节点，但必须明确说明说明你的选择 。每个真实节点必须包含颜色属性，实现代码必须维护以下不变量 ： 每个节点要么是红色，要么是黑色；根节点是黑色 。 所有 叶子节点都被视为黑色 。 红色节点的子节点必须都是黑色 。 从任意节点到其后代 叶子节点的所有路径上，包含相同数量的黑色节点 。 必须实现插入修复（Insertion fix-up）和删除修复（Deletion fix-up）；不得使用标准库的有序集合或树函数替代你自己的实现 。报告中必须解释每种修复步骤处理的情况，给出不变量维持的证明概要，并给出所有必需操作的最坏情况界限 。 AI 使用规定： 禁止使用 。AI 不得编写或重写红黑树实现、修复情况处理、伪代码、证明或复杂度分析 。 4. 标准树输出与可测试性 两种实现都必须提供 print_standard() （或文档中说明的等效函数），输出格式必须是确定性的、可进行逐字节对比的结构 。使用括号递归打印树：每个真实节点写为 (value left right) ，其中 left 和 right 是其子节点的括号表示形式 。缺失的子节点写为 () ，因此空树表示为 () 。 对于 AVL 树，仅打印节点的值 。 对于红黑树，打印节点值及其颜色标志 :R 或 :B ； 不要 打印高度元数据 。 节点内部的标记用单个空格分隔，结尾不要添加多余空格 。 例如，一个有效的红黑树输出如下 insertion） ； 包含成功查找、失败查找、插入和删除的混合负载 。 在计时前进行预热（Warm up），计时区域内 排除 输入生成和打印的时间；每个测量重复足够的次数以报告稳定的统计数据，并说明你报告的是均值、中位数还是其他统计量 。在每个工作负载结束后验证正确性并调用 validate() 。报告实际经过的时间（Wall-clock 对于实验设计决策、数据收集、数据解读、理论解释和绘图， 禁止使用 AI 。仅在第 4 节允许的范围内可以使用 AI 生成的绘图/测试样板代码；所有数据必须来自你自己的运行结果 。 6. 红黑树改进建议 根据你的测量结果以及文献/AI 辅助的研究，探讨改善红黑树或相关平衡二叉搜索树的一个可能方向 。以下是几个宽泛的研究方向，你可以选择其中之一或提出其他有据可查的方向 ： 内存表示、分配与局部性（Locality） ； 平衡维护与更新策略 ； 并发与并行处理 ； 感知工作负载（Workload-aware）的结构与操作 。 说明核心思想、预期收益以及主要权衡（Trade-off） 。明确区分已实现的结果和提议的研究方向，并在适当位置引用相关文献来源 。 AI 使用规定： 允许使用 ，但仅限于研究和头脑风暴改进建议、寻找相关参考文献以及比较可能的研究方向 。任何原型代码、测量数据和最终的技术判断必须由你独立完成并明确标识 。 7. 提交内容要求 将所有文件放入名为 pj1 的目录中 。该目录必须包含 ： 两种树及通用驱动程序的源代码 ； 自动化测试代码以及运行测试所需的微型测试数据 ； README （或 README.md ），说明先决条件、编译器/解释器版本、构建命令、测试命令、实验运行命令、命令行参数、输入格式、输出格式以及如何复现实验数据 from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

import math

    return math.comb(n, r)

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where

    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where

    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where

    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where

    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

from scipy.stats import hypergeom


def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):
  for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # 计算 P(X >= q)，其中总体为 m，背了 k，抽样 n
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    if prob >= target:
      return k
  return m

from scipy.stats import hypergeom

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6
target = 0.8

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N) - wait, scipy's hypergeom takes (k, M, n, N) where
    # M = total population, n = number of successes in population (here our k is number of known questions), N = sample size (n here)
    # Let's verify scipy signature: hypergeom.cdf(k, M, n, N)
    # X = number of successes in sample. We want P(X >= q) = 1 - P(X <= q - 1)
    prob = 1 - hypergeom.cdf(q - 1, m, k, n)
    print(f"k = {k}: P(X >= {q}) = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):
    if r < 0 or r > n:
        return 0
    return math.comb(n, r)

m = 12
n = 9
q = 6

for k in range(q, m + 1):
    # Total ways to choose n from m
    total_ways = comb(m, n)
    # Ways to choose x known questions (where x >= q) and (n - x) unknown questions
    favorable_ways = 0
    for x in range(q, min(n, k) + 1):
        favorable_ways += comb(k, x) * comb(m - k, n - x)
    prob = favorable_ways / total_ways
    print(f"k = {k}, favorable = {favorable_ways}, total = {total_ways}, prob = {prob:.4f}")

import math

def comb(n, r):

def calculate_k(m, n, q, target=0.8):

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

Here is a comprehensive overview of the scholarship evaluation guidelines detailed in the document: Eligibility Requirements The scholarship evaluation applies to registered undergraduate students in the 2025 AI Leaders Class for the 2025-2026 academic year . Students are disqualified if they take a leave of absence (with limited exceptions), take fewer than 4 courses or 10 credits, or fail their comprehensive assessment . Other disqualifying factors include having unpassed make-up exams, violating school rules, failing the physical fitness test, or participating in illegal activities . Evaluation Criteria Academic and Business Learning (80%) : Course grades account for 70% of the total score, calculated by scaling the student's total GPA to a 70-point scale . Comprehensive Quality (20%) : This section is graded out of a 100-point raw score, which is then scaled into the final score using the formula Y = 10 + 0.1 × raw score . Specific prorated formulas are applied to students who transferred into the class from Xianghui College during the winter break to combine evaluations from both their former and current classes . Application Process Students applying for the scholarship must submit the application form (Annex 2) to the evaluation group's email (yushutian@fudan.edu.cn) by 12:00 PM on September 20 . Students who voluntarily choose not to participate must submit a physical waiver declaration (Annex 3) to the counselor's mailbox by the exact same deadline . Failure to submit either document by the deadline is considered an automatic waiver, and the student will not participate in any rankings . nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

Here is a comprehensive overview of the scholarship evaluation guidelines detailed in the document: Eligibility Requirements The scholarship evaluation applies to registered undergraduate students in the 2025 AI Leaders Class for the 2025-2026 academic year . The comprehensive quality raw score evaluates four areas: Ideological and Moral (25 points), Class Life (15 points), Social Work (40 points), and Sports and Arts (20 points) . Specific prorated formulas are applied to students who transferred into the class from Xianghui College during the winter break to combine evaluations from both their former and current classes . Application Process Students applying for the scholarship must submit the application form (Annex 2) to the evaluation group's email (yushutian@fudan.edu.cn) by 12:00 PM on September 20 . Students who voluntarily choose not to participate must submit a physical waiver declaration (Annex 3) to the counselor's mailbox by the exact same deadline . Failure to submit either document by the deadline is considered an automatic waiver, and the student will not participate in any rankings . Here is a comprehensive overview of the scholarship evaluation guidelines detailed in the document: Eligibility Requirements The scholarship evaluation applies to registered undergraduate students in the 2025 AI Leaders Class for the 2025-2026 academic year . Students are disqualified if they take a leave of absence (with limited exceptions), take fewer than 4 courses or 10 credits, or fail their comprehensive assessment . Students who voluntarily choose not to participate must submit a physical waiver declaration (Annex 3) to the counselor's mailbox by the exact same deadline . nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.prose: The text in the image you shared reads: “谈及论文是提到的综述是什么” (This appears to be a slight typo for “谈及论文 时 提到的综述是什么”, meaning "What is a 'review' when talking about academic papers?"). Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

Here is a comprehensive overview of the scholarship evaluation guidelines detailed in the document: Eligibility Requirements The scholarship evaluation applies to registered undergraduate students in the 2025 AI Leaders Class for the 2025-2026 academic year . The comprehensive quality raw score evaluates four areas: Ideological and Moral (25 points), Class Life (15 points), Social Work (40 points), and Sports and Arts (20 points) . Specific prorated formulas are applied to students who transferred into the class from Xianghui College during the winter break to combine evaluations from both their former and current classes . Application Process Students applying for the scholarship must submit the application form (Annex 2) to the evaluation group's email (yushutian@fudan.edu.cn) by 12:00 PM on September 20 . Students who voluntarily choose not to participate must submit a physical waiver declaration (Annex 3) to the counselor's mailbox by the exact same deadline . Failure to submit either document by the deadline is considered an automatic waiver, and the student will not participate in any rankings . Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

Here is the straightforward answer: In the context of academic papers, a “综述” (Literature Review or Review Article) is a comprehensive survey, summary, and evaluation of existing research on a specific topic. Unlike an original research paper (which presents new experimental data or primary research), a review paper does not create new data. Instead, it synthesizes what is already known. Key Purposes of a Review (综述) Summarize Past Research: It helps readers quickly understand the history, current state, and major milestones of a specific research field without having to read hundreds of individual papers. Evaluate and Analyze: It compares different methodologies, findings, and theoretical approaches across various studies, often pointing out contradictions or consensus. Identify Gaps: By mapping out what is already known, a good review highlights what is missing or unknown, pointing out directions for future research. You will typically see "综述" in two forms: As a standalone paper: An entire article dedicated to reviewing a field (e.g., a "Review Article" in a journal). As a section within a paper: The "Literature Review" section at the beginning of a standard research paper, which sets the stage and provides background for the new research being presented.

nodes.text:
是的，Giffgaff 保号确实是每 6 个月（更准确地说是 186 天）需要进行一次产生计费的操作。

£10 余额能保几年？

理论上，10 英镑最高可以保号近 17 年！（如果只在英国本土发短信保号的话）

它的具体年限取决于你 人在哪里 以及 采用哪种方式 保号：

1. 人在英国国内（使用英国本土网络）

保号方式：每 6 个月向任意英国号码发一条普通短信（短信费为 10p/条）。

计算：£10 余额可发送 100 条短信。

保号时长：

100 次×0.5 年=50 年（受限于各种资费调整，实际建议按长线规划即可）。

2. 人在中国（漫游使用）

保号方式：每 6 个月在中国漫游状态下向任意号码（包含中国手机号）发送一条短信（Giffgaff 在中国漫游发短信资费一般为 30p/条）。

计算：£10 余额可发送 33 条漫游短信。

保号时长：

33 次×0.5 年≈16.5 年。

⚠️ 保号的几个重要提醒

必须是“产生计费”的操作

可以：发一条短信、拨打一个接通的电话、使用几 KB 的移动流量（非 Wi-Fi）、或者进行一次 £10 充值。

不可以：仅接收短信/验证码（免费，不计入保号操作）、给 0800 等免费号码打电话。

谨防数据流量“偷跑”

漫游或日常使用时，务必在手机设置里关闭该卡的数据流量，否则后台应用一旦消耗了几 MB 流量，这 £10 余额几天内就会被扣光。

设置日历提醒

你说 我人在中国，给谁发消息保号合适？

nodes.dom_prose: 我人在中国，给谁发消息保号合适？

nodes.text:
人在中国时，给谁发短信保号主要取决于你的需求和发送对象。以下是几种最合适、最常见的选择：

1. 发送给自己的另一个中国手机号（最推荐）

做法：用带有 Giffgaff 卡的手机，给你的国内手机号（如中国移动、联通、电信）发一条短信。

优点：

完全私密：不会打扰任何人。

验证方便：你可以直接在国内手机上看到短信是否送达，确保保号动作成功。

成本可控：漫游发短信单价虽然稍高（大约 30p/条），但半年才发一次，10 英镑能撑好几年。

2. 发送给自己的另一个海外虚拟号 / 备用号

做法：如果你有 Google Voice、TextNow、原生实体卡（如香港、澳门或其他国家的卡），可以互发短信。

优点：同样不打扰别人，且双向都能测试号码的可用性。

3. 发给熟络的朋友或家人（需提前打好招呼）

做法：给关系非常好的亲友发一条诸如“giffgaff 保号测试”之类的短信。

缺点：如果对方不知道情况，可能会觉得莫名其妙，或者回复你导致产生额外的接收/回复费用。

💡 核心注意事项（保号防翻车）：

格式要正确：从中国发短信给国内手机号时，格式通常是 +86 加上你的国内手机号（或者在输入框里手动把国家/地区代码选为中国 +86）。

信号与漫游：确保手机开启了数据漫游（Data Roaming），并且网络运营商显示的是中国联通、中国移动或中国电信的漫游网络（通常需要有信号塔信号才能发出去）。

关闭流量开关：再次提醒，发完短信后务必把该卡的移动数据流量关闭，避免后台应用偷跑流量导致 £10 余额快速扣光！

这张截图展示的是 Giffgaff 中的 Premium numbers（特种付费/高资费号码） 设置界面。这类号码不同于普通的手机号或座机号，通常用于商业服务、电视抽奖、捐款、竞猜或订阅类信息服务。

页面各项功能解析
1. Make calls（拨打特种号码电话）

开关状态：开启（绿点）。

资费说明：25p per minute + service charge（每分钟 25 便士基础费 + 对方公司收取的服务费）。

作用：开启后，允许你拨打英国的 09、118、084、087 等高资费热线电话。

2. Receive texts（接收付费短信）

开关状态：开启（绿点）。

资费说明：Up to £10 per text（接收一条短信最高可被扣除 10 英镑，具体金额由发送方服务商决定）。

作用：这是英国的一种“订阅付费短信（Premium Rate SMS）”机制。如果你在某些网站或电视节目中输入手机号订阅了服务，对方向你发送短信时，会从你的 Giffgaff 余额中扣钱。

⚠️ 针对你的情况（国内保号/日常使用）的建议：

如果你只是放在手机里接收普通的银行/APP验证码以及半年发一次短信保号：

强力建议关闭 Receive texts（接收付费短信）开关：

开启这个功能有被恶意扣费的风险（比如不小心订阅了国外不知名的付费短信服务，收到一条可能就会被直接扣掉几英镑，甚至直接把你 £10 的余额清空）。

请放心：关闭此开关完全不会影响你接收微信、银行、Google 等正常 APP 的登录验证码！普通验证码都是免费接收的。

建议关闭 Make calls（拨打特种号码）开关：

避免意外误拨高资费电话导致话费被快速消耗。如果平时不需要拨打英国的商业热线，关掉最安全。

nodes.text:
这个功能叫 Credit spend cap（话费消费封顶上限）。

1. 结论：开不开都行，对你影响不大

对于保号用户（余额只有 £10）：开不开几乎没区别。
因为这个开关的作用是将每月话费消耗上限设为 £45/月。你的账户里总共才 £10 余额，远远达不到 £45 的封顶线。

建议：如果系统允许打开，顺手开着（Turn On）也无妨，算是一道额外的防线。

2. 为什么图片上显示红色报错？

页面红字显示：

“Sorry, this setting is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.”
（抱歉，此设置暂时不可用，请稍后再试。）

原因有两个：

giffgaff 系统临时故障/维护：这种提示在 giffgaff App 刷出时很常见，可以不用理会，或者过段时间/在网页端再试。

时间段限制：Giffgaff 的消费上限开关每天只在英国时间 4:05 am 至 9:55 pm 之间开放修改，如果在系统结算维护时间段点击，就会提示不可用。

3. 真正对你重要的防护措施（回顾）

相比这个 £45 的封顶上限，防范余额流失最有效的设置是：

Auto top up（自动充值）：保持关闭（防止余额不足时自动从银行卡扣钱充值）。

Premium numbers -> Receive texts（接收付费短信）：保持关闭（防止高资费订阅短信扣钱）。

蜂窝移动数据：在手机设置里关闭 giffgaff 卡的数据流量（防止偷跑流量扣余额）。

因为这个开关的作用是将每月话费消耗上限设为 £45/月 。你的账户里总共才 £10 余额，远远达不到 £45 的封顶线。 建议 ：如果系统允许打开， 顺手开着（Turn On）也无妨 ，算是一道额外的防线。 2. 为什么图片上显示红色报错？ 页面红字显示： “Sorry, this setting is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.” （抱歉，此设置暂时不可用，请稍后再试。） 原因有两个： giffgaff 系统临时故障/维护 ：这种提示在 giffgaff App 刷出时很常见，可以不用理会，或者过段时间/在网页端再试。 时间段限制 ：Giffgaff 的消费上限开关 每天只在英国时间 4:05 am 至 9:55 pm 之间开放修改 ，如果在系统结算维护时间段点击，就会提示不可用。 3. 真正对你重要的防护措施（回顾） 相比这个 £45 的封顶上限，防范余额流失最有效的设置是： Auto top up（自动充值） ：保持 关闭 （防止余额不足时自动从银行卡扣钱充值）。 Premium numbers -> Receive texts（接收付费短信） ：保持 关闭 （防止高资费订阅短信扣钱）。 蜂窝移动数据 ：在手机设置里 关闭 giffgaff 卡的数据流量 （防止偷跑流量扣余额）。

这是一封 Giffgaff 官方发出的关户/断网通知邮件。

邮件的主要内容是：系统检测到你的 Giffgaff 卡（尾号 1895）长期在英国境外（国内）漫游使用，违反了其“仅限英国本土使用及短期漫游”的条款。官方决定近期直接切断服务并注销该号码，且明确强调这是最终决定（final position），基本无法申诉恢复。

🚨 当务之急：请按以下顺序处理
1. 最高优先级：立即解绑/更换关键账号手机号（最重要！）

趁现在号码还没有完全停信号，立刻去更换所有绑定了该英国手机号的账号验证码：

金融类：英国银行卡（Monzo、HSBC、Barclays 等）、PayPal、Wise、加密货币交易所等。

社交/工具类：Google、WhatsApp、Telegram、微信、Apple ID 等。

处理方式：将绑定的手机号更改为你的国内手机号，或者其他能正常接码的号码。一旦断网，你将无法接收任何 OTP 登录验证码。

2. 尝试索要 PAC 码（保住原号码转网）

如果你非常想保留这个尾号 1895 的号码：

尝试用手机发送短信 PAC 到 65075，或者登录 Giffgaff 官网/App 寻找 Get a PAC code。

如果能拿到 PAC 码，可以在 30 天内把这个号码转入其他支持长期海外漫游的运营商（例如 CMLink 英国卡等）。

注意：如果账户已经被锁定，可能无法获取 PAC 码，但依然值得试一下。

3. 联系 Agent（客服）申请退还 £10 余额

登录 Giffgaff 官网，进入 Help -> Ask an Agent（提交工单）。

告知客服你的账户即将被关闭，申请将账户里剩余的 £10 话费余额 退回到你最初充值付款的银行卡/PayPal。

💡 为什么会被封号？后续怎么避坑？

Giffgaff 虽然很适合在海外保号接码，但如果连续 60~90 天以上只有海外漫游数据/通话记录，或者被系统判定为“从未使用过英国本土基站”，就会触发风控被封卡。

如果你以后还需要英国号码接验证码：

重新办一张 Giffgaff 新卡：用新邮箱和新卡重新激活，充值 £10 保持纯保号（平时只接验证码，半年主动发一次短信，不要开启任何移动流量数据）。

转用 CMLink（中国移动英国卡）：对国内长期漫游的容忍度更高，更适合长期国内留用。

这里为你准备了一份适合直接复制发送给 Giffgaff 客服（Agent）的英文退款申诉模板。

📩 沟通话术模板

建议提交分类：登录官网或 App -> Help -> Ask an Agent -> 选择 "Account details and settings" -> "Cancelling my account / Refund" （或任意能留言的客服页面）。

Subject: Request for credit refund due to account closure

Message:
Hi Giffgaff Agent,

I recently received an email stating that my service will be disconnected due to extended roaming outside the UK.

Since my service is being terminated, I would like to request a refund of my remaining unused credit balance (£10) back to my original payment method.

Here are my account details for verification:

Member Name / Username: [你的 Giffgaff 账号用户名]

Mobile Number: [你的 Giffgaff 手机号，如 07xxx xxxxxx]

Email Address: [你的注册邮箱]

Please kindly process the refund and let me know if you need any further information from my side. Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
[你的名字]

💡 提交前的小提醒：

原路退回：话费余额通常只能退回当初充值该 10 英镑时使用的银行卡或 PayPal 账户。如果那张银行卡已经过期或销户，请在邮件末尾额外补充一句说明（例如：Note: My original payment card has expired, please let me know how I can receive the refund.）。

回复时间：Giffgaff 客服通常会在 24 小时内回复（可在 App 内 Help -> Messages from agents 中查看回复）。

nodes.text:
这里是针对这两个问题的直接解答和操作建议：

1. 65075 要加上 +44 吗？

不要加，加了也发不出去，而且在国内漫游时发给 65075 大概率会失败。

原因：65075 是英国本土的特种短码（Shortcode），不支持添加 +44 国家码格式（+4465075 是无效号码）。此外，当你人在中国漫游时，国内的基站网络通常无法识别并路由英国的 5 位数短码。

正确做法（人在国内获取 PAC 码）：
直接登录 Giffgaff 官网网页版 或 App 获取：

登录你的 Giffgaff 账号。

点击右下角 Account -> 找到 Profile details。

找到 Get a PAC code（获取 PAC 码）选项并点击。

系统会直接在屏幕上显示 6 位数的 PAC 码，并同步发到你的注册邮箱。

2. 转入其他运营商后，余额还有吗？

没有了，£10 余额不会跟着转移，转网成功后余额会直接清零。

话费无法跨运营商转移：英国不同运营商（如从 Giffgaff 转到 CMLink、EE 等）之间的系统是独立的，转网只会把你的“手机号码”带过去，新卡的余额依然需要重新充值。

转网会导致账户自动注销：只要新运营商成功激活并使用了你的 PAC 码，Giffgaff 侧的账户就会被自动关闭，剩余的流量和余额会全部失效。

💡 最佳处理顺序（既保号又保钱）：

第一步：先在 Giffgaff 官网/App 里获取 PAC 码（PAC 码有效期为 30 天）。

第二步：立刻给 Agent 发送退款申请（使用上面给你的英文模板），要求退还 £10 余额到你的原支付卡。

第三步：拿到新运营商的卡后，将 PAC 码提交给新运营商完成号码转入。

总结：仅“获取”PAC 码本身不会自动注销账号；但在你目前的情况下，如果不使用 PAC 码转网，账号依然会被 Giffgaff 强制注销，且号码会彻底作废。

具体原因和机制如下：

1. 正常情况下（没有收到封号邮件时）

PAC 码的有效期为 30 天。

如果你向运营商申请了 PAC 码，但一直没有去新运营商那里提交使用，30 天后这个 PAC 码就会自动失效。

你的 Giffgaff 账号和手机号会完好无损地保留在 Giffgaff，不会被注销。

2. 你的特殊情况（已经收到关户通知邮件）

Giffgaff 邮件里已经明确告知：“your service will be disconnected shortly”（你的服务将在近期被切断）。

这意味着 Giffgaff 已经在对你的账号执行强制销户流程。

风险点：如果你申请了 PAC 码却不用，一旦 Giffgaff 的强制关户流程执行完毕（或者 30 天 PAC 码过期），你的手机号就会被系统彻底回收，以后再也无法找回或转出了。

💡 针对不同诉求的最终建议：

方案 A：如果这个号码绑定了很多重要账号，你必须保留号码

必须尽快使用 PAC 码！

赶紧找一个支持国内漫游且对长期海外留用较宽容的英国运营商（例如 CMLink 英国卡 或 Lebara 等），下单购买一张新卡，并在新运营商后台提交你的 Giffgaff PAC 码，把号码抢救过去。

方案 B：如果这个号码不重要，你打算直接放弃

你可以完全不用管 PAC 码。

抓紧时间把绑定的重要验证码改走。

找客服（Agent）申请退还 £10 余额，等待 Giffgaff 自动断网关户即可。

nodes.text:
客服给出了最终裁决：拒绝复机，并且拒绝退还 £10 话费余额。

这份回复的主要内容拆解如下：

1. 拒绝恢复服务

客服表示理解你的不快，但无法撤销断网决定，也无法恢复你的号码。他们强调 giffgaff 的服务仅限英国本地居民或短期海外漫游使用，系统确认你长期在英国境外使用，违反了《公平使用政策（FUP）》和服务条款第 3.5(k) 条。

2. 拒绝退还 £10 余额

关于申请退款，客服明确拒绝了。理由是根据服务条款第 5.3 条（T&C 5.3），话费余额（Credit）一旦充入账户，在没有法律或监管强制要求的情况下，运营商没有义务办理退款。

3. 账户状态

你的账户已经被正式关闭（Closed），所有关联的使用权限都已经终止。

💡 你现在该怎么办？

既然官方已经堵死了复机和退钱的路，目前唯一重要且紧急的事情就是：

抢救账号绑定（最关键）：趁现在或者赶紧检查一下，所有用这个英国手机号注册/绑定的重要账号（银行卡、微信、Google、WhatsApp、PayPal 等），立刻将绑定手机号更改为你的中国手机号或其他可用号码。

尝试转网（如果还想保留这个号码）：尝试在网页后台看看还能不能导出 PAC 码。如果能拿到 PAC 码，可以尝试转入其他对境外漫游更宽松的运营商（如 CMLink 英国卡）；如果系统已经全盘锁定拿不到 PAC 码，那这个号码就只能放弃了。
